annotation.title_clean: European Parliament resolution of 27 February 2014 on the use of armed drones (2014/2567(RSP))
annotation.title_en: European Parliament resolution of 27 February 2014 on the use of armed drones (2014/2567(RSP))
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 285/110 (29.8.2017)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution expressing grave concern over armed drone use outside the international legal framework. It urges an EU common position, a ban on extrajudicial targeted killings and on fully autonomous weapons, inclusion of armed drones in arms control regimes, greater transparency and accountability, and human rights impact assessments for drone R&D.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a ban on development, production and use of fully autonomous weapons operating without human intervention
Urges Council to adopt an EU common position on armed drones
Calls to ban extrajudicial targeted killings and include armed drones in arms control regimes
Demands transparency, judicial review and remedies for victims of unlawful drone strikes
Requests human rights impact assessments and reporting on EU funds for drone R&D
